name: Gabriel E. Birkenmeier

events.title: Marriage
events.description: Married Caroline C. Kratz (1856–1930), born at Venice, Erie Co., Ohio. Children: Frank Joseph (3 Dec 1884 – 4 Apr 1930), Agnes (1886–1904), Leonard (1889–1958), Rhea T. (1893–1977; married Chas. W. Prentice in Michigan).

bioAdditions: After his 1880 stay with his sister's family in Hazleton, Gabriel settled in Sandusky, Ohio. There he married Caroline C. Kratz, an Ohio-born woman from Venice in Erie County, and had at least four children (S2). The death certificate of his eldest son Frank Birkmaier names Gabriel as a native of Baden, Germany. Frank was a single machinist of 223 Shelby St who died at Providence Hospital, Sandusky, on 4 Apr 1930, aged 45. His mother is named on the certificate as Caroline Kratz of Venice, Ohio, and he was buried at St Mary's Cemetery on 7 Apr 1930 (S1). FamilySearch gives Gabriel's own burial at St Mary's, Sandusky, in Dec 1896. It also attaches an Ohio county birth entry (G. Birkmeyer as a father) and his daughter Rhea's Michigan marriage to Charles W. Prentice (S2).
openQuestionsNew: Sandusky Register obituary, Dec 1896, which may name his brother Joseph and his Hazleton sister.
Erie County, Ohio probate death register 1896.

confidenceRecommendation.justification: His son's death certificate confirms the Baden origin.
